title: Build a Transformer
motto: Thirteen lessons. One model. No shortcuts.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Thirteen lessons. One model. No shortcuts.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You've read every paper. You've implemented attention, multi-head splits, positional encodings, encoder and decoder blocks, BERT and GPT losses, MoE, KV cache. Now make them work together on a real task.

The capstone: train a small decoder-only transformer end-to-end on a character-level language modeling task. It reads Shakespeare. It generates new Shakespeare. It is small enough to train on a laptop in under 10 minutes. It is correct enough that swapping in a bigger dataset and longer training gets you a real LM.
